statements.status_notes: GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree (and subpackages), which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release. Scout matches golang.org/x/crypto at the module level because the advisory records the module with no fixed version. Analysis of this image's shipped Go binaries found no import or link of golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp; the vulnerable OpenPGP code is therefore not present in the shipped artifacts (vulnerable_code_not_present).

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Debian zlib packages (zlib1g and zlib1g-dev) do not ship the untgz utility by default. For Debian Trixie (and other versions), zlib comes from zlib1g (binaries) and does not include the untgz binary. The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.

This is not security vulnerability. The xslt random function provided by libxslt does not offer any security or cryptography guarantees. Applications using libxslt that rely on non-repeatable randomness should be seeding the system PRNG (srand()) themselves, as they would if calling rand() directly.
